title: Research construction: R439 phase-B blocks 506/523 to 24/39 ADDs + certified single-write class boundaries (no new kappa)
body:
﻿**Finite bit-supplier construction + scoped class-boundary survey; no new kappa.** One class search over all ten phase-B blocks of [PR 589](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/589)'s tuned punctured R439 word, two shortenings spliced into one verified word, and certified boundaries where the class cannot shorten.

| quantity | before | after |
|---|---:|---:|
| block 506 (`B[102:128)`, frame 506) | 26 | **24** |
| block 523 (`B[404:449)`, frame 523) | 45 | **39** |
| complete exported local ADDs | 24,305 | **24,289** |
| forward positive bound | 49,347 | 49,347 (equal) |
| composed reverse positive bound | 1,113,070 | **1,090,494** |
| payload | 93 bits | 93 bits (cap 104) |
| paid profile / rank mass | `{1:1323, 2:1342, 3:79, 4:44, 5:102, 6:11, 7:19}` / 5,129 | unchanged |

All 661 register frame paths identical, exact F2 endpoint on all 661 dirty-input columns, inherited H1–H5 conclusions hold via the pinned `xcheck_p.py`, bills and positive/payload bounds recomputed via the pinned `export_records.py`. Twelve mutation controls rejected.

**Survey (whole-block single-write class of PR #873):** class minima are 24 (frame 506), 30 (frame 508 — independently reproducing #873's certified minimum exactly), 39 (frame 523). Seven blocks have **no** program in the class: frames 507/519/520/522/524 carry order-independent per-row donor-supply certificates (e.g. 507 row 3 needs column 4 three times; every donor whose row fits carries it once), frames 509 and 521 are global order obstructions certified by two independent exhaustive recursions (forward subset DP in `search.py`, backward Bellman in `verify.py`, which imports no search code). These are scoped class statements, not impossibility theorems.

**Frame 523 vs open [PR 857](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/857):** their best published witness is 40 gates (randomized factorization, reverse prefix grown to 1,228,514, payload 94). The 39-gate witness here is a certified class minimum with a distinct mechanism; its local reverse map is not entrywise dominated but the whole-word reverse prefix *drops* to 1,090,494 with payload staying 93. Their implementation and savings are not imported.

**Concurrent arrivals, disclosed:** open [PR 880](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/880) (frame 507, fixed-factor class, 35→30) and open [PR 884](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/884) (frame 521, 47→31) landed after this survey's search finished; both are exactly the blocks certified infeasible here, so their shorter programs must use factor-level intermediate donors or multi-write interleavings — independent structural evidence for their mechanisms, not competition for the same claim. Frames 506 and 523 remain uncovered by any other open PR.

Reproduce (standard-library Python 3.11+, ~90 s):

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r439-bsection-survey/search.py
python3 -I -B research/r439-bsection-survey/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_R439_BSECTION_SURVEY`, `spliced_frames [506, 523]`, `adds 24305 -> 24289`, `reverse_positive_bound 1090494`, `payload_bits 93`, 12 controls rejected. `search.py` regenerates `CANDIDATES.json`/`CERTIFICATE.json` byte for byte. Receipt red test (tampered `EXPECTED.json` rejected) and three development defects caught by these checks are recorded in `VALIDATION.md`.

Base **`f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631`** (selected [PR 799](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/799)/[PR 589](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/589), conditional κ 0.001661634653669567). Only `research/r439-bsection-survey/` is added; `upstream/` and selected inputs unchanged. OS assignment seed **8**, bit-supplier track; no pinned coordination issue existed (only #650 open), so the claim is recorded in `CLAIM.md`. No native C++/hosted invoice/global assembly/cold replay/Lean/remote CI run here; inherited realization/compiler/hosting/precision/tape/analytic assumptions remain; no new kappa (complex-bound as before).
